text: {"lessons":["My repeated quick sales of winners and delayed acceptance of losses show how strongly purchase price and the pleasure of realizing gains can distort my decisions; I should reassess each stock on its current prospects, not its personal-account gain or loss.","Buying Stock B again after selling it at a gain, then selling later at a loss, reminds me that a realized win does not make a repurchase sound; I need a clear reason and risk limit for every trade.","Losses in Stocks B and C after adding or re-entering show that frequent trading is not a substitute for a disciplined plan; I should consider the portfolio as a whole and avoid reacting to short-term price moves."]}
